name: Contacts
description: People and organizations on this device: who they are, your history, relationships and contact details. Copies your old Smart Contacts on first use and imports read-only from macOS Contacts. AI can look people up, add and update entries, and tidy groups and duplicates.
whenToUse: An unknown email, phone or Feishu/Slack/GitHub account; contacting or messaging someone; background before a meeting or reply; news about a colleague, friend, family member or client (new job, leaving, new contact, plans); organizing, de-duplicating or importing contacts.

find.description: Find people by any clue: name, alias, email, phone number, Feishu/Slack/GitHub id, or a keyword from their company, projects or events. Returns up to limit people with summary, identities, groups, notes for AI and recent events; matchType is identity (exact identity match, most reliable), name (exact name or alias), partial (a stored name is contained in the clue, e.g. a full name finding an entry saved with a given name only; confirm it) or text (contained in text).

/properties/query.description: The clue as written, e.g. zhixia@example.com, 138 0000 0000, Connie, the person who works on payments

get.description: Read one full entry by id: identities and contact details, all events (newest first), story, notes for AI, groups and relationships. The id comes from find or list.

list.description: List entry summaries page by page (no story or full events), optionally filtered by group, status or type. Use it to browse or review the to-confirm queue; use find for a specific person.

/properties/status.description: pending = waiting for the user to confirm

save.description: Create or update an entry. Without id it creates: if the name is similar to an existing entry it returns DUPLICATE_SUSPECT with candidates; use get to check whether it is the same person, update by id if so, and pass allow_duplicate only if not. With id it updates only the fields you pass; aliases, identities and groups are appended, never removed. If an identity belongs to someone else it returns IDENTITY_CONFLICT with conflictContactId.

/properties/id.description: Entry id to update; omit to create

/properties/aliases.description: Aliases, English names or nicknames to add

/properties/summary.description: One-line intro: who they are, where, what they do. Replaces the old value

/properties/narrative.description: Long-term background and your story together, a few natural sentences. Replaces the old value; get the current text first and rewrite it

/properties/agent_notes.description: Handling notes for AI, such as preferred channel or how to address them. Replaces the old value

/properties/status.description: Use pending for uncertain information so the user can confirm

/properties/identities.description: Identities and contact details to add

/properties/identities/items/properties/.description: email / phone / feishu / slack / github / wechat / telegram / x, lowercase

/properties/groups.description: Group names to join; missing groups are created

/properties/allow_duplicate.description: Pass true only after confirming it is not the same person as the similar entry

log_event.description: Add a dated event to someone: a notable interaction, agreement or change.

/properties/text.description: One or two sentences on what happened, with needed context

relate.description: Record or remove a relationship between two entries, such as same team, manager, or works at a company.

/properties/relation.description: Relationship, e.g. same team, former manager, works at

organize.description: Organize in bulk: add to a group, remove from a group, move to a group (leaving other groups), confirm to-confirm entries, or mark as to confirm.

/properties/group.description: Group name; required for group actions, created if missing

merge.description: Merge the source entry into target, then delete source: identities, events, groups and relationships move over, aliases are combined and stories joined. Use only after the user confirms they are the same person.

/properties/target_id.description: Entry kept; pick the more complete one

delete.description: Delete an entry with its identities, events and memberships. This cannot be undone. Call with confirm:true only when the user explicitly asks to delete.

/properties/confirm.description: Pass true when the user explicitly asked to delete

groups.description: Manage groups: list shows all groups with member counts, create, rename, or delete a group (people in it are kept).

/properties/name.description: Group name; required except for list

find_duplicates.description: Scan for pairs of entries with similar names. Use when the user asks to tidy up or suspects duplicates; get both sides of each pair, then ask the user before merging.

import_macos.description: Import read-only from macOS Contacts; system contacts are never changed. By default dry_run only returns how many entries would be created, completed or skipped; pass dry_run:false after the user agrees. Cards with the same email, phone or system anchor join existing entries; new entries with similar names go to the to-confirm queue. The first run asks for macOS permission and returns PERMISSION_DENIED if refused. Mac only.

/properties/group.description: Optional: put imported people in this group

stats.description: Contacts overview: people, organizations, to confirm, groups.

save_many.description: Create or update up to 100 entries at once, with the same rules as save. Use it to import client lists, spreadsheets or business cards. Returns a result per item; a failed item (e.g. DUPLICATE_SUSPECT, IDENTITY_CONFLICT) does not affect the others, so resolve failures one by one as with save.

/properties/items.description: Each item has the same fields as save

/properties/items/items/properties/id.description: Entry id to update; omit to create

maintenance.description: Start and finish automatic maintenance. begin returns the last checkpoint, the per-run change limit, the guidance for the current profile (mostly colleagues / many clients) and an overview; after tidying up, call end to record what was scanned and changed and the new checkpoint, which the user sees in Contacts. Use only in the maintenance automation or when the user asks to tidy up contacts.

/properties/checkpoint.description: For end: the time processed up to (ISO 8601), usually the now returned by begin

/properties/scanned.description: For end: conversations or emails read in this run

/properties/pending.description: Entries written as to-confirm in this run

/properties/note.description: Optional one-line note, up to 300 characters
